blocks.explanation:
Yeh improper fraction hai: upar aur neeche dono ki degree 4.
Is liye seedha shakal likhna ghalat hoga; pehle division kar ke polynomial hissa alag karna hai.
Find kya karna hai? Polynomial hissa aur proper hisse ki partial fractions.
Plan: divide, \(1 - x^4\) ke factors, \(x = 1\) aur \(x = -1\) se \(A\) aur \(B\), coefficients se \(C\) aur \(D\), phir wapas jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{x^4}{1 - x^4}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Yahan pehla sawal yeh hai ke fraction proper hai ya nahi. Top aur bottom dono ki degree 4 hai, is liye yeh improper hai. Improper fraction ko pehle divide kar ke ek polynomial (quotient) aur ek proper fraction mein likhte hain, phir sirf proper fraction ko torte hain. Uske baad \(1 - x^4\) ke poore factors banayenge: do linear aur ek irreducible quadratic.

Fraction ko proper banayein
\[x^4 = -(1 - x^4) + 1\]
\[\dfrac{x^4}{1 - x^4} = \dfrac{-(1 - x^4) + 1}{1 - x^4}\]
\[= -1 + \dfrac{1}{1 - x^4}\]
Kyun: Top aur bottom dono ki degree 4 hai, is liye fraction improper hai, aur improper fraction ko seedha partial fractions mein nahi tora ja sakta. \(x^4\) ko \(-x^4 + 1\) se divide karein to quotient \(-1\) aur remainder 1 aata hai. Yahi baat upar wali line dikhati hai: \(x^4 = -(1 - x^4) + 1\). Ab sirf proper hissa \(\frac{1}{1 - x^4}\) torna hai; \(-1\) aakhir tak saath chalega.
Dhyan dein: \(-1\) ko jawab mein likhna bhool jana is sawal ki sab se aam ghalti hai.

\(1 - x^4\) ke factors banayein
\[1 - x^4 = (1 - x^2)(1 + x^2)\]
\[= (1 - x)(1 + x)(1 + x^2)\]
Kyun: Difference of squares \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) do dafa lagaya: pehle \(1 - (x^2)^2\), phir \(1 - x^2\). Lekin \(1 + x^2\) squares ka jama hai, is ke real factors nahi bante. Is tarah do linear factors aur ek irreducible quadratic mile.

Partial fractions ki shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{1}{(1 - x)(1 + x)(1 + x^2)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{1 - x} + \dfrac{B}{1 + x} + \dfrac{Cx + D}{1 + x^2}\]
Kyun: Har linear factor ke upar ek constant (\(A\), \(B\)) aur quadratic \(1 + x^2\) ke upar \(Cx + D\). Linear aur quadratic dono qisam ke factors hain, is liye Case I aur Case III ke qaide ikatthe lagte hain.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[1 = A(1 + x)(1 + x^2)\]
\[+ B(1 - x)(1 + x^2)\]
\[+ (Cx + D)(1 - x^2) \quad \text{(i)}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf poore denominator se multiply kiya. Har numerator ke saath woh factors reh gaye jo us ke neeche nahi the. \(Cx + D\) ke saath \((1 - x)(1 + x)\) bacha, jo difference of squares se \(1 - x^2\) hai. (i) har \(x\) ke liye sach hai.

(i) mein \(x = 1\) aur \(x = -1\) rakhein
\[x = 1:\ 1 = A(2)(2) = 4A\]
\[A = \dfrac{1}{4}\]
\[x = -1:\ 1 = B(2)(2) = 4B\]
\[B = \dfrac{1}{4}\]
Kyun: \(x = 1\) rakhne se \(1 - x = 0\), is liye \(B\) wala aur \((Cx + D)(1 - x^2)\) wala term zero; sirf \(A\) bacha. Isi tarah \(x = -1\) se \(1 + x = 0\), aur sirf \(B\) bacha. Dono dafa \(1 + x^2 = 2\) hai.

(i) ki right side kholein
\[A(1 + x)(1 + x^2)\]
\[= A + Ax + Ax^2 + Ax^3\]
\[B(1 - x)(1 + x^2)\]
\[= B - Bx + Bx^2 - Bx^3\]
\[(Cx + D)(1 - x^2)\]
\[= D + Cx - Dx^2 - Cx^3\]
Kyun: \(C\) aur \(D\) kisi value rakhne se seedhe nahi milte, kyunke \(1 + x^2\) kabhi zero nahi hota. Is liye har bracket khol diya taake powers ikatthi ki ja sakein.
Dhyan dein: \(-x \times x^2 = -x^3\); minus wale terms sambhal kar likhein.

Powers ke hisaab se ikattha karein
\[1 = (A - B - C)x^3\]
\[+ (A + B - D)x^2\]
\[+ (A - B + C)x\]
\[+ (A + B + D) \quad \text{(ii)}\]
Kyun: Teeno lines ko jama kar ke har power ke coefficients ek jagah ikatthe kiye. Ab left side 1 ke saath compare karna aasaan hai: left par \(x^3\), \(x^2\), \(x\) ke coefficients 0 hain aur constant 1 hai.

(ii) mein coefficients compare karein
\[x^3:\ 0 = A - B - C\]
\[C = A - B = 0\]
\[\text{const}:\ 1 = A + B + D\]
\[D = 1 - \dfrac{1}{4} - \dfrac{1}{4} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: Left side sirf 1 hai, is liye \(x^3\) ka coefficient 0 aur constant 1. \(A = B = 1/4\) rakhne se \(C = 0\) aaya, matlab \(1 + x^2\) ke upar sirf constant \(D\) reh gaya. Yeh is liye hua ke fraction mein sirf \(x\) ki even powers hain.

Baqi coefficients se parakh
\[x^2:\ A + B - D\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4} + \dfrac{1}{4} - \dfrac{1}{2} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[x:\ A - B + C = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh do equations humne istemal nahi ki thin. Left side par \(x^2\) aur \(x\) dono nahi, is liye dono 0 honi chahiye, aur 0 hi aayin. Constants pakke hain.

Jawab likhein
\[\dfrac{x^4}{1 - x^4} = -1 + \dfrac{1}{4(1 - x)}\]
\[+ \dfrac{1}{4(1 + x)} + \dfrac{1}{2(1 + x^2)}\]
Kyun: Division se mila \(-1\) wapas likha aur constants rakhe. \(\frac{1/4}{1 - x} = \frac{1}{4(1 - x)}\), aur \(C = 0\) ki wajah se \(\frac{Cx + D}{1 + x^2} = \frac{1}{2(1 + x^2)}\).

Tasdeeq: fractions ko wapas jorein
Common denominator \(4(1 - x)(1 + x)(1 + x^2)\); top:
\[(1 + x)(1 + x^2) + (1 - x)(1 + x^2)\]
\[= 2(1 + x^2)\]
\[2(1 - x)(1 + x) = 2 - 2x^2\]
\[\text{Top} = 2 + 2x^2 + 2 - 2x^2 = 4\]
\[-1 + \dfrac{4}{4(1 - x^4)} = \dfrac{-(1 - x^4) + 1}{1 - x^4}\]
\[= \dfrac{x^4}{1 - x^4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Teeno fractions ka common denominator \(4(1 - x^4)\) liya. Top 4 aaya, yani teeno ka jama \(\frac{1}{1 - x^4}\) hai. Phir \(-1\) jorne se bilkul \(\frac{x^4}{1 - x^4}\) wapas mil gaya, jo asal sawal hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\frac{x^4}{1 - x^4} = -1 + \frac{1}{4(1 - x)} + \frac{1}{4(1 + x)} + \frac{1}{2(1 + x^2)}\)
Book ki answer key mein is sawal ka jawab nahi; yeh jawab humne khud nikal kar check kiya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein Sawal 4 ka jawab nahi. Key mein "3" ke number wala pehla jawab, \(\frac{-2}{13(x + 3)} + \frac{2x + 33}{13(x^2 + 4)}\), jorne par \(\frac{3x + 7}{(x + 3)(x^2 + 4)}\) banta hai, jo is exercise ka sawal hi nahi. Sahi jawab, jo upar nikal kar check kiya gaya hai: \(-1 + \frac{1}{4(1 - x)} + \frac{1}{4(1 + x)} + \frac{1}{2(1 + x^2)}\).
